text: Event Types - The alarm system shall support the following event types; Fault, Error, Warning.
Event Priority - The alarm system shall associate a priority level with each event type, from highest to lowest in the following order; Fault, Error, Warning.
Audio Alarm Indicators - The system shall use sound as an audible indication of alarm type.
Audio Fault Event Indicator - The system shall indicate the occurrence of a fault type alarm by emitting an audible TBD within 5 second of the triggering event
Audio Error Event Indicator - The system shall indicate the occurrence of a error type alarm by emitting an audible TBD within 10 second of the triggering event
Visual Alarm Indicator - The system shall use color as a visual indication of alarm type
Visual Fault Alarm Indicator - The system shall use 'red' coloration to indicate a fault alarm type in UI displays
Log File Location - The system data logging function shall create log directories on the internal disk storage device in the 'Data' directory
Log File Operations - The data logging function shall create, modify, delete log data files in an asynchronous fashion.
Event Log File Update Interval - The event log files maintained by the data logging function shall be updated at 5 minute intervals
